title: Lanyte Naming Conventions
description: Reusable definitions for instance names, scope paths, role slugs, and generic slug identifiers. All segments are lowercase alphanumeric + hyphens, no leading/trailing hyphens, max 63 chars per segment (DNS label compatible). No URL escaping required anywhere.

slug.description: Single slug segment. Lowercase alphanumeric + hyphens, no leading/trailing hyphens. Max 63 chars. DNS label compatible. The atomic building block for all naming conventions.

instance-name.description: Dot-separated slug segments (FQDN pattern). Each segment max 63 chars. Total max 253 chars (DNS FQDN limit). Examples: 'dev-local', 'lanytehq.prod', '3leaps.staging.us-east-1'. Valid in S3 paths, CLI flags, DNS, config, logs.

scope-path.description: Slash-separated slug segments. Variable-depth org hierarchy. Examples: 'lanytehq' (org-wide), '3leaps/ipcprims' (project-scoped), 'lanytehq/lanyte/crates/gateway' (deep path).

role-slug.description: Role identifier. Starts with a letter (not a digit) to avoid ambiguity with channel numbers and numeric identifiers in logs and queries. Slug-compatible. Examples: 'cxotech', 'devlead', 'secrev'.
